golden.answer: SEP-43 is the Draft Standard Web Wallet API Interface (v1.2.1 as of 2026-11-14). It defines the JavaScript API a web wallet exposes to dapps: getAddress, signTransaction, signAuthEntry, signMessage and getNetwork, with standard error codes. Dapps integrate once instead of writing per-wallet code. It is not an authentication or anchor standard.
keyFacts: SEP-43 is the Standard Web Wallet API Interface for dapp-to-wallet calls.
It defines getAddress, signTransaction, signAuthEntry, signMessage and getNetwork.
It standardizes error shapes so dapps need no per-wallet code.
avoid: Do NOT claim that SEP-43 does not exist, or is an authentication, anchor or payment standard.
golden.notes: SEP-43 is Draft; do not penalize an answer that states a later dated version.
